project.title: FinSight AI — Semantic Intelligence & Financial Reconciliation Platform
project.short_description: Database-first financial intelligence platform transforming raw banking transactions into explainable insights via IBM Db2 12.1 native vector search, LangChain tool grounding, and memory-safe Rust API gateway.

ibm_db2.edition: IBM Db2 Community Edition (Linux/x86_64 v12.1.5.0, FINDB)
ibm_db2.connector: ibm_db / SQLAlchemy (ibm_db_sa) / LangChain Db2 vector integration
features_used: Native Db2 VECTOR Datatype (384-dimensional dense embeddings)
Transactional Session Store and Audit Logs (FINSIGHT.SESSIONS)
